purpose: Execute the unchanged six-case V5 readiness after adding only the repository src-path bootstrap omitted by V1.

approval.scope: One immutable six-case V1R startup-only replacement under standing autonomous authorization.
approval.confirmation_reference: User authorized optimal in-scope execution without repeated approvals.

sampling.independent_units: Two development worlds at environment seed 11; checkpoint seeds quantify model variation and are not independent worlds.

method.main: Unchanged V5 graph correction on frozen V9 semantics and M-TARE local stack.
method.compatibility_change: Import tools/v3/_bootstrap.py before mtare_topo; no scientific code or threshold change.
method.baseline: Earlier V9 readiness is interface evidence; readiness itself draws no performance conclusion.
method.fallback: Existing frozen B0 direction fallback only.
method.thresholds: Per case: travel >=5m, nodes >=2, verified edges >=1, non-hold target, zero failed cycles and post-warmup fallback <=5%.

evidence.expected: Failed V1 source seal, six lossless bags, case metrics, V5 traces/snapshots, summary, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.pass: All six fixed cases pass every readiness/storage gate with exact V5/V3 identities and zero forbidden operations.
evidence.fail: Any source/tool/image/checkpoint drift, case failure, fallback excess, archive failure or forbidden read.

estimated_cost.compute: Six serial 180-second CPU/Gazebo inference cases; zero training and zero GPU requirement.
